The father and son spent the two next years preparing for the massacre, radicalizing their views, training with ISIS in the Philippines.
🚨The police suspected them, but did nothing.

On December 14, in the Hanukkah party on Bondi beach , it was already too late.💔

There is a direct connection between hate marches and the massacre of Jews.

The authorities across the West should have clamped down on the incitement years ago.
 It is too late for the dead, and, if they do not finally act, it will soon be too late for the West as well.

#FightAntisemitism 
#SydneyTerroristAttack

🇺🇸🇯🇵 The Pentagon just billed Tokyo $100 M for an Aegis "software update"

This ain’t a routine tune-up: Lockheed Martin patching Japan's missile destroyers to keep them tethered to Washington's Indo-Pacific war machine and kill chain!
https://t.co/LUyZXvBhTA

That $100M? A distraction. This "readiness insurance" software update is really "escalation-as-a-service" and a VIP pass to America’s war network

The deal isn't new hardware. It's sustainment—CSSQT trials, software patches, engineering support.

Because when your whole navy runs on American code, "interoperability" means you can't fire a missile without filing a U.S. tech support ticket!

 "Independent ally"? Pffft - More like a locked iPhone

Post-upgrade, US commanders in Hawaii or Guam won’t just “share data” with Japan’s ships. They could remote-control its radars. Even fire its weapons. Japan’s “self-defense” ships? Now they’re Uncle Sam’s floating surveillance cams—and missile launch pads. 🎮

The US’s calculation) is cynical even by imperial standards:

→ Stick Japan on the First Island Chain frontline (read: right next to Taiwan/East China Sea)
→ Team America? It parked the USS Washington carrier in the Philippine Sea—safe, far from the fire
→ Risk? “Shared” (read: dumped on Tokyo). Profit? Lockheed cashes in! Hegemony? Locked down!

And let’s dissect the US’s latest lie: “This won’t upset regional balance.” Sure, whatever. After the upgrade, Japan’s Aegis hits “Baseline 9”—carbon copies of US warships integrating advanced Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) with traditional air defense (IAMD). Now both can fire offensive 1,800km Tomahawks cruise missiles putting Chinese cities in the firing line🤥

The excuse? Chinese coast guard near "Senkakus" and "Taiwan-adjacent operations."

The Reality: China operates within 200 miles of its own coastline, while Taiwan is officially recognized by everyone as part of China 

Meanwhile the U.S. Navy runs 400+ bases encircling China, but sure—the "threat" is the country next door

The projection is almost artistic (actually autistic might be the better term)

As explained in my previous posts and threads this doesn't happen in a vacuum. It's AUKUS nuclear subs + QUAD naval drills + Philippines bases + Taiwan arms deals—all pieces of the same containment puzzle.

The strategy: Turn allies into forward-deployed sensors and missile platforms for an annual fee while integrating them into the US Kill Chain for the Pacific 

Modern US Imperialism, now comes even with 24/7 tech support
